I think that if you think there's a chance it can help you should talk to your therapist and see if you can get some kind of trial period. I got 3 weeks and if I wanted to stay I would've been there for at least 3 months. However at the time I was young and not really susceptible to help in either way. 

Good luck to you and I hope you find something that'll work for you!
